about: SANTE COSMETICS (the Dr.SANTE brand) is a Korean aesthetic brand with more than 20 years of history (since 2003). The company develops and manufactures professional skincare cosmetics, combining years of hands-on experience, professional expertise and a focus on skin health.
The brand's philosophy is skin health and beauty at the same time. The products are created for the professional segment and are designed for sensitive, dry, irritated and mature skin.

lines.name: Azulene Soother
lines.note: A soothing line with guaiazulene and chamomile water: it quickly reduces irritation, lowers skin temperature and strengthens the barrier, addressing the root causes of sensitive-skin concerns. Creams, serums, masks, lotions, mists, gels and sun-protection essences.

lines.name: Artemisia AKA
lines.note: A line for problem-prone and irritated skin: as stated by the company, it has a pronounced soothing effect and helps reduce the look of irritation. Ampoules, creams and masks for repair and barrier care.

lines.name: Collagen Leader
lines.note: Collagen-based care focused on firmness and mature skin.

lines.name: Hyalquad Core
lines.note: Intensive hydration based on a hyaluronic acid complex.

lines.name: Elsol
lines.note: A botanical oils line built around premium Israeli jojoba oil, USDA-certified, unrefined and cold-pressed. As stated by the company, its structure is close to that of the skin barrier, which helps restore and strengthen it.

lines.name: Hair Care
lines.note: Scalp and hair care on chamomile flower water: a shampoo and a treatment with the patented YUKMIJIHWANG complex, guaiazulene and eco-ceramide oil. 500 ml bottles and travel sticks.

tech.name: Guaiazulene + chamomile water
tech.note: Real Blue Calming Solution — soothes irritated skin, lowers its temperature and strengthens the protective barrier.

tech.name: LHASOL™
tech.note: A proprietary 4th-generation ingredient — stabilized LHA in high concentration. As stated by the company, it has an exfoliating action on keratinised cells and helps problem-prone skin return to a healthy, slightly acidic pH.

content.exportNote: Dr.SANTE products are supplied to more than 30 countries — among them the United States, Canada, the Czech Republic, Greece, Japan, China and Taiwan — and are present in over 8,000 aesthetic salons and clinics worldwide. As stated by the company, official partners are in place in China, Japan, Taiwan, Canada, Hawaii, Australia (online), Hong Kong, Macau, Greece, Argentina and Russia. The company exhibits at Cosmoprof, Beautyworld, InterCHARM and K-Beauty Expo.
content.consentNote: The data and materials are provided by SANTE COSMETICS and published with its written consent. Teranova coordinates and supports the deal.

catalog_notes: A cleanser maintaining a mildly acidic pH 5.5 close to the healthiest skin state; hypoallergenic, moisturizing, soothing and reinforcing the skin barrier.
Mildly acidic, hypoallergenic cleansing milk (pH 5.5) that removes daily makeup and even sunscreen, leaving a moisture barrier without tightness.
Toner based on Chamomile flower extract and azulene instead of purified water, with 50,000 ppm Mt. Jirisan mint extract to soothe and hydrate; Aquaporin processing for deeper hydration.
Gel product on a Chamomile flower water base. Quickly calms, cools and hydrates skin irritated by outdoor activity, sunlight, UV, heating or air conditioning.
Soothing Azulene Soother care in a compact stick format.
Lotion with real blue azulene on a Chamomile flower water base. Contains panthenol and ceramide NP; passed hypoallergenic tests for sensitive, infant and children skin.
Ampoule for sensitive skin with a high azulene content well known among aesthetic brands. Strong soothing, moisture retention and protection.
Cream in the natural deep-blue azulene color with no artificial dyes. Strong soothing, moisture retention and protection, balancing water and oil for healthier skin.
Wash-off cream mask on Chamomile flower water with 1,000 ppm guaiazulene, 20,000 ppm dexpanthenol and 8 types of hyaluronic acid. Moisturizes, soothes and softens the skin.
Peeling serum with PHA and LHA on a Chamomile flower water base. Gently removes dead skin cells without irritation, moisturizes and adds glow.
Biocellulose sheet mask, essence on 87% Chamomile flower water for quick soothing and hydration. 4th-generation restorative sheet adheres tightly and delivers active ingredients.

A semi-gel sheet mask on chamomile flower water with guaiazulene: soothes and hydrates. A dedicated neck sheet is included. The sheet is natural bamboo fibre gelified with water — it adheres closely and limits moisture loss.
Non-drying gel modeling pack with 79% Chamomile flower water and azulene. Instantly soothes heated skin and reinforces the moisture barrier.
Mist spray for genuine calming, relaxing, moisturizing and nourishing of tired and irritated skin.
Sun essence on a Chamomile flower water base with 11 types of hyaluronic acid; hydrates all day while protecting from UV. Sophora root extract soothes and preserves moisture.
A hydrating cushion on chamomile flower water with guaiazulene: thin, natural-looking coverage, panthenol and ceramide NP. Airless container and a rubycell puff; a refill is included.
A BB cream from the Azulene Soother line: light coverage on a caring base of chamomile flower water and guaiazulene. 35 g.
A professional massage cream on chamomile flower water with guaiazulene, olive oil, wheat germ oil and shea butter. No-wipe, absorbable; suitable for face, body and device treatments. 1,000 ml.
Toner pads of gelated natural bamboo fiber. Gently adhere, prevent moisture loss and deliver active ingredients all day with a wrapping effect.
Refill for the Azulene Soother Semi-Gel Toner Pad.
Weakly acidic soothing toner that controls excess sebum and improves pores; suitable for daily use even on sensitive skin.

A soothing ampoule with Artemisia Capillaris extract. As stated by the company, LHA-SOL™ and niacinamide gently regulate excess sebum and refine pores, while AKA-DERM™ is a blend of six botanical extracts and moisturising ingredients.
A soothing cream with Artemisia Capillaris extract, LHA-SOL™ and AKA-DERM™ for sensitive skin with visible pores. CERAVITE™ supports hydration and strengthens the skin barrier.
Face & neck semi-gel mask: as stated by the company, it helps keep the skin clean and comfortable, soothes it quickly and improves the look of blemishes.
Vegan pad from eco-friendly cotton and Tencel. Does not tear or stretch, adheres without irritation and absorbs toner into the skin.
A BB cream from the Artemisia AKA line on a caring base, for sensitive and blemish-prone skin. 35 g.
A toner from the Collagen Leader line with hydrolysed collagen for firmness and hydration. Three formats: 500 and 200 ml, plus the 100 ml Bubble Toner.
An ampoule with hydrolysed collagen and a peptide complex for firmness and density. 100 ml.
A cream with hydrolysed collagen, human stem cell conditioned media and six types of peptide. Ceramide NP, panthenol, vitamin B12 and rosa centifolia flower water for hydration and radiance. 150 g.
A sheet mask from the Collagen Leader line for firmness and hydration. Pack of 10 sheets.
An ampoule built on the HyalQuad-4 system: four types of hyaluronic acid of different molecular weights, hydrating at different depths. 100 ml.
A cream built on the HyalQuad-4 system with the TE HA complex, sacran, squalane and shea butter; as stated by the company, NAD and resveratrol support skin radiance. 50 and 200 g.
Reliable top-grade jojoba oil from Israel, USDA-certified. Unrefined cold-pressed for higher antioxidant effect; its structure is close to the skin barrier and helps rebuild and reinforce it.
Reliable top-grade jojoba oil from Israel, USDA-certified. Unrefined cold-pressed for higher antioxidant effect; its structure is close to the skin barrier and helps rebuild and reinforce it.

A shampoo on chamomile flower water with the patented YUKMIJIHWANG complex and magnolia bark extract. Guaiazulene and eco-ceramide oil nourish the scalp and hair. Free from animal-derived ingredients, mineral oil, artificial colorants, seven types of paraben and silicone. 500 ml bottle and 5 ml sticks.
A hair treatment from the same line: guaiazulene and eco-ceramide oil soften the hair and ease combing. 500 ml bottle and 5 ml sticks.
A perfumed hand cream with panthenol and hyaluronic acid, in a Rosewood Vanilla scent. Lightweight, fast-absorbing and non-sticky. 55 ml.
